name: USPTO utility / design drawings (37 CFR 1.84) — minimal profile

_sources.rule: paper: A4 (21.0 × 29.7 cm) or Letter (21.6 × 27.9 cm); all sheets the same size
margins: top ≥ 2.5 cm, left ≥ 2.5 cm, right ≥ 1.5 cm, bottom ≥ 1.0 cm; sight ≤ 17.0 × 26.2 cm on A4; no frame around the sight; scan target points (cross-hairs) on two catercorner margin corners
numbers, letters and reference characters ≥ 0.32 cm (1/8 in) high; not in brackets / circles; English alphabet
sheet numbering: consecutive Arabic numerals, sheet number / total sheets separated by an oblique line, middle of the top of the sheet but not in the margin, larger than reference characters
view numbering: consecutive Arabic numerals preceded by the abbreviation FIG.; view numbers larger than reference characters
legends: as few words as possible; English

_verification_note: 2026-10-19：条文按 eCFR 当前版本整理；当日本机无法连通 ecfr.gov（SSL 握手失败），上线前须按上面链接逐条复核并更新本字段（见 docs/release-v0.2.0-checklist.md）。
_note: Minimal profile: paper / margins / sight, FIG. N captions, n/total sheet numbers, 0.32 cm text floor, English-only text on the filing copy, cross-hair targets. NOT covered: shading (1.84(m)), colour and photographs (1.84(a)(2), (b)), Letter paper (profile is A4; Letter later), solid-line character rules beyond CONTINUOUS. Acceptance by the office is final; not legal advice.
